sentences.text: NIDO Contech is a cohort company whose country is recorded as ES, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
CORDIS lists an EU project that started on 2026-06-01 with EUR 202 125 attached to it, and the radar reads that as a first public grant.
The record has four award entries, the latest two dated 2026-08-25 and 2026-08-31, and a first customer or pilot named on 2023-10-31.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09 and an exhibitor or demo entry is dated 2026-08-19.
On the radar's rules technology and business readiness are both level 4 and investment readiness is level 3, resting on the EU project.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, but with more dated evidence than most of the cohort.
